name: Appearance-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method for reconstructing static scenes from unconstrained in-the-wild photo collections by decoupling intrinsic object properties from extrinsic appearance conditions (lighting/post-processing) and removing transient objects.
summary: Appearance-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs static scenes from unconstrained photos by decoupling appearance from geometry and using a lightweight 2D mask to exclude transients, unlike heavier NeRF or SWAG methods.
